name: Rule Engine
description: Assigns values from the first matching boolean rule, like a CASE expression, and appends the result as a new column. The output type is inferred from the rule values.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Name of the appended result column.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Ordered rules; the first rule whose condition is true wins.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: SQL boolean expression over the input columns.

value.title: Value
value.description: Scalar assigned when the condition is true; its SQL literal type follows the JSON type.

elseValue.title: Else value
elseValue.description: Scalar assigned when no rule matches; missing means NULL.
